Embedded Systems

Embedded systems are everywhere.

What are embedded systems? They are:

  • Computational systems, but not merely small computers;
  • Designed for specialised functionality within a larger system;
  • Often reactive, continually responding to their environment;
  • Designed to satisfy requirements beyond functionality, such as timing and resource constraints.

Embedded System Design

Embedded-system design is a process from high-level models to implementations on heterogeneous platforms through:1

  • Refinement: introduce implementation detail.
  • Transformation: modify a model to obtain a new one at the same abstraction level.
